name: Register lantern:::ui, reporting that Chaos isn't there until L7

comments.text: GameUiApi.nox registers Mount, Unmount and SetNavigation in the Rust host's order. Mount fails with Rust's message for a missing Chaos, "GameUi isn't available: Chaos didn't start". L7 replaces it. The host-surface test now matches 149 rows and skips the 4 that Chaos adds.
